title: Pork chops on a creamy sweetcorn and potato bake

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a plain home staple: potatoes, corn cobs, cream, milk, cheddar, pork chops and tomatoes.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including fresh corn cobs in October, is an everyday item at Tesco.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a baking dish, foil, a knife and a grater, and layering a bake is easy beginner technique.

works.reason: 400ml of cream and milk to 750g of thinly sliced potato, baked covered for 35 minutes and then 25 more at 200°C, will cook through, and the chops will be done in 25 minutes.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes is a fair estimate for slicing the potatoes, cutting corn from four cobs and the small jobs, and the 60 minutes of cooking matches the 35 plus 25 in the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm creamy bake suits a mid-October evening, and kernels from four cobs make the sweetcorn a main part of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, homely British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a proper family dinner of pork, potatoes, sweetcorn and tomatoes.
